description: Read a stored Web Scan report by its slug (the part after /r/ in a web-scan.agentmarket.lol/r/<slug> link) without re-scanning: score, grade, scan time and the failing or warning checks with fixes. Use this when the user shares a report link. Reports expire after two weeks; to check the current state of a site, use scan_url or verify_fixes instead.

slug.description: Report slug, e.g. "k3m9p2x7qa", or the full report URL.

name: get_report
title: Get a stored report
